title: BNCI 2014-009 P300 dataset
description: A P300 brain-computer interface EEG dataset from 10 healthy, BCI-experienced participants who selected among 36 characters using two interfaces: the overt-attention P300 Speller and the covert-attention GeoSpell. Sixteen-channel EEG was recorded with BCI2000 across multiple sessions, and the data support analysis of P300 latency jitter and its relationship to classification accuracy.
methods_description: Scalp EEG was recorded from 16 Ag/AgCl electrodes (10-10 layout) with a g.USBamp amplifier at 256 Hz. Electrodes were referenced to linked earlobes with a right-mastoid ground, and the data were band-pass filtered at 0.1-20 Hz. Visual stimulation and acquisition used BCI2000. Each trial had eight stimulation sequences, with a 125 ms intensification and a 125 ms inter-stimulus interval (250 ms SOA). Each subject performed three runs per interface in each session.
